access: Public Influint pages and existing source catalogue; no authenticated intelligence connector or private Studio access.
system_readback: Public thumbnail battery measures pixel brightness, contrast, color and edge density. It does not measure depicted faces, composition semantics or motivation. Gaming packaging claims consulted were labelled Theory and unmeasured.
decisions: Keep the requested luminous blue-sky aesthetic with photographic host identity.
Use one large promise and a small secondary invasion group, with five visibly different layouts.
Make the opening gameplay fulfill the visible thumbnail promise; public packaging theory is a hypothesis, not a forecast.
Do not call the user-selected Earth reference a winning outlier: source reports 0.81x and its row window is unresolved.
limits: Lift is source-reported against nearby-upload medians from October 5, not CTR and not evidence that a composition caused performance. Exact portal, Flood and multiverse precedents remain gaps.

variants.comparison: Giant object reveal: one host and one impossible world. The user-selected Earth thumbnail supplies the aesthetic; the experiment and gadget examples support the broad host-plus-object layout. No exact multiverse composition outcome is established.
